Both channels are LIVE -- they recover obligate complexes -- so this is a statement about

and co-expression about transcriptional co-regulation; neither is a claim that one gene
ACTS ON another's substrate. Most metabolic enzymes are also non-essential in culture,
where the medium supplies what the pathway would make, so their profiles are near-flat.
